title: Doodle Art — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Idea to system
scenes.purpose: A sleepy lightbulb doodle has an idea, then links out to four mint friends that wake up and join into one connected system, with the headline on a white reading card.
visuals: Cool blue-grey graph-paper sheet that doesn't move, with a soft vignette
Peach lightbulb character with a Rough.js ink outline, three fixed outline variants tied to poses, and sleepy/aha/happy expression groups
Four mint circle characters whose faces swap from sleepy to smiling
Hand-drawn connection strokes and dotted cross-links
Opaque white rounded card with dark ink Chalkboard SE headline and a mint underline

beats.development: The sleepy bulb (dash eyes) holds still while a white thought bubble pops in. Its three ellipsis dots appear one by one only after the bubble shape is complete.

Anticipation squash, then an AHA stretch: the face swaps to round eyes and an open mouth, the bubble pops away and the light rays draw on. The bulb settles with a back-ease, and its outline variant changes with each pose.

Four links draw outward from the bulb. Each mint node pops in where its line ends and wakes into a smile. Dotted cross-links then close the network, while the white title card arrives and its copy appears once the card is complete.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system!

beats.development: The mint underline finishes, the bulb gives a happy nod and settles by 2.45s, and the full composition holds still for reading.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system!

findings: The idea reaction (wondering, then squash, then stretch, then settle) happens before the network grows, so the viewer finds the bulb first and then follows the lines outward.
The headline is fully legible from about 1.8s, giving at least 1.2s of reading time for 6 words.
justifiedHolds: 2.45–3.0s: still reading hold on the settled system and headline.

notes: No preview_recipes are listed in STYLE.json, so this refresh shows the primary Doodle Art style (line variants tied to poses plus replaceable expression groups) on a new cool graph-paper background based on the source-frame review.
